table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AliasName=name1,
	AccountName=name2, 
	Date=Date1, 
	DocCode=name3, 
	Age=code2,
	AgeGroup=code3,
	Amount=Value1,
	Paid=Value2,
	Balance=Value3,
	Remarks=Name4,
	LastPaymentDate=Date2
FROM 
	Reportdata 
ORDER BY
	AccountName, AliasName, Date, Age Desc, AgeGroup
table.sort: accountname A, aliasname A, date A, age D, agegroup A

objects.name: c_agegroup
objects.expression: case( agegroup when 0 then 'Current (0)' when 1 then '1-' + trim(string(ai_interval)) when 2 to ai_limit then trim(string(agegroup)) + '-' +  case(agegroup+ai_interval-1 when IS > ai_limit then trim(string(ai_limit)) else trim(string(agegroup + ai_interval - 1)) ) ELSE '> ' + trim(string(ai_limit)) )
